items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: The interviewee is Sonny Williams. The transcript shows the Interviewer and another person (likely a guest or family member) identifying themselves as 'Dick Allen'. Sonny Williams does not describe a personal relationship with Dick Allen, only that the name was mentioned in the context of the record

ctx.x: Well, stop it for a minute. You want to put your name on here? Marjorie Zander. And how about putting your name on here since you're listening too? Houston. Mm-hmm. And you're his son? Older son. Mm-hmm.
Well, let's see. We were talking about Eddie Atkins and you were mentioning somebody. Eddie Atkins, that's my homeboy. Yeah. I'm Dick Allen. Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm .
